mechanism: Both agents cause CNS depression through different pathways (trazodone via serotonergic/alpha-adrenergic mechanisms, meprobamate via GABAergic effects), resulting in additive depressant effects on the central nervous system.
action: Avoid concurrent use or use only with careful monitoring and dose adjustment; counsel patients on avoiding alcohol and other CNS depressants, and monitor for excessive sedation, respiratory depression, and impaired cognition.
